FD-P2-06.subject: INV-B06 / INV-D02 semantics

INV-B06.behaviour: advance (purpose='advance') dated on the booking business date before arrival; refund at cancellation
INV-B06.recommendation: refine: admit purpose='advance' on/before arrival and cancellation refunds on/before cancellation; keep behaviour

INV-D02.classification: business-semantics ambiguity (refund reverses an advance balance, not one row)
INV-D02.recommendation: refine: accept a reversal row referenced by reservations.cancellation_refund_payment_id; keep behaviour
